description: This file contains automated test cases for verifying syslog daemon functionality and configuration in an embedded Linux environment, including starting, stopping, and logging to syslog.

classes.name: SyslogTest
classes.description: Test case class for verifying syslog daemon is running.

classes.name: SyslogTestConfig
classes.description: Test case class for verifying syslog configuration and restart procedures.

methods.name: test_syslog_running
methods.description: Checks if a syslog daemon process is running.

methods.name: verif_not_running
methods.description: Verifies that specified PIDs are not running.

methods.name: verify_running
methods.description: Verifies that specified process names are running and collects their PIDs.

methods.name: restart_sanity
methods.description: Restarts syslog services and verifies they restart correctly.

methods.name: test_syslog_logger
methods.description: Tests logging into syslog and verifies log entry appears.

methods.name: test_syslog_restart
methods.description: Attempts to restart syslog services using various commands.

methods.name: test_syslog_startup_config
methods.description: Tests syslog startup configuration and logging after configuration change.
